newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Brussels bourse names small caps mkt intermediary.
newsitem.headline: Brussels bourse names small caps mkt intermediary.

text.p: The Brussels bourse on Wednesday named Riga et Cie SA as the eleventh intermediary which planned to participate in the exchange's "Nouveau Marche" for small- and medium-sized firms set to be launched in January 1997.
The Nouveau Marche, or New Market, is part of the EURO-NM project involving the Paris, Frankfurt and Brussels bourses. The Amsterdam bourse has also shown an interest.
Paris set up its Nouveau Marche in February. The German counterpart is due to be started up in 1997.

The 10 other intermediaries are Banque Bruxelles Lambert SA ; Banque Paribas Belgique SA; Degroof Securities SA; Dewaay, Servais & Cie SA; Generale de Banque SA; KB- Securities NV; Nedee & Co (part of CERA group); Petercam SA; Puilaetco; Smeets Verbaet & Co, NV.
